note: Smart IP data-source submodule. 'Abstract' is the vendor brand (abstractapi.com), NOT an abstract PHP base class. It registers the Smart IP source id 'abstract_web_service' via an event subscriber (SmartIpEventSubscriber extends the parent's SmartIpEventSubscriberBase; sourceId()/configName()). It becomes active only when smart_ip.settings:data_source == 'abstract_web_service'. Its own settings live in smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings (version:int=1, api_key:string required). Lookups call AbstractWebService::V1_URL (https://ipgeolocation.abstractapi.com/v1/) per request and need a paid/registered API key, so medium/hard tiers are grounded in the source-selection + api_key CONFIG (smart_ip.settings + smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings), never live geolocation calls.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the smart_ip_abstract_web_service submodule enabled, which Smart IP config key and value make the Abstract IP Geolocation web service the active geolocation data source?
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to 'abstract_web_service' (the source id this submodule contributes). e.g. drush config:set smart_ip.settings data_source abstract_web_service -y.

evals.prompt: What settings does the smart_ip_abstract_web_service submodule store, in which config object, and what web-service endpoint does it call?
evals.expected_output: It stores version (integer, only 1) and api_key (required) in the config object smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings. Lookups hit AbstractWebService::V1_URL = https://ipgeolocation.abstractapi.com/v1/. Form validation blocks selecting the source without an API key.

evals.prompt: How does the smart_ip_abstract_web_service submodule plug into Smart IP as a data source — what class does it extend and what identifies the source?
evals.expected_output: It provides an event subscriber SmartIpEventSubscriber that extends the parent Drupal\smart_ip\SmartIpEventSubscriberBase (which implements SmartIpDataSourceInterface). sourceId() returns 'abstract_web_service' and configName() returns 'smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings'; processQuery(), formSettings(), validateFormSettings(), submitFormSettings() etc. implement the source contract.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the Abstract IP Geolocation Smart IP data source configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the API key currently stored for it.
evals.expected_output: The key is abstract_test_key_9f3a, stored at smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings:api_key (read it with drush config:get smart_ip_abstract_web_service.settings api_key).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Smart IP to use the Abstract IP Geolocation web service (the smart_ip_abstract_web_service submodule) as its active geolocation data source, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to 'abstract_web_service' (e.g. drush config:set smart_ip.settings data_source abstract_web_service -y). In production you would also store an Abstract api_key; the verify checks only the source selection.
